BAMLH0A0HYM2.display_name: ICE BofA US High Yield Index Option-Adjusted Spread

HYG_IEF.formula: HYG split-adjusted close / IEF split-adjusted close on matching trading dates
HYG_IEF.release_note: The pre-Alpaca archive is retained. New observations use Alpaca free IEX daily bars on matching dates only; no forward fill or estimated values are used.

DFEDTARU.frequency: Policy decisions, normally eight scheduled FOMC meetings per year
DFEDTARU.release_note: The chart uses the discontinued DFEDTAR target rate through 2008-12-15 and DFEDTARU thereafter. Daily as-of observations are drawn as a step line. The next official update follows the scheduled FOMC decision date; unscheduled decisions can occur earlier.

CME_EXPECTED_POLICY_RATE.unit: Percent, probability-weighted target range upper limit
CME_EXPECTED_POLICY_RATE.release_note: Each observation is the probability-weighted upper limit expected for the next scheduled FOMC meeting at that time. The rolling series switches to the following meeting after an FOMC decision.

ICSA.release_note: Weekly initial unemployment-insurance claims. The observation date is the Saturday ending the reported week, not the Thursday release date.

DTWEXBGS.release_note: The Federal Reserve publishes these daily observations in a weekly H.10 batch, so the latest observation can remain several business days behind the calendar date while still matching the source.

FINRA_MARGIN_DEBT_YOY.release_note: Usually published during the third week of the following month.

ACMTP10.source_name: Federal Reserve Bank of New York

source_urls.label: New York Fed Treasury Term Premia

ACMTP10.release_note: Adrian, Crump, and Moench ACM Daily sheet, column ACMTP10. Public redistribution terms for committed derived CSV data are not explicitly confirmed.

NFCI.display_name: Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index

ISM_MANUFACTURING_PMI.source_name: Institute for Supply Management via PR Newswire
ISM_MANUFACTURING_PMI.release_note: Released on the first business day of the month at 10:00 a.m. ET. The updater parses the revised rolling 12-month table in ISM's latest official press release; no proxy or estimated values are used.

RSP_SPY.release_note: Uses matching Alpaca IEX daily bars only; no forward fill or estimated values are used.

SPY_TLT.formula: SPY split-adjusted close / TLT split-adjusted close on matching trading dates
SPY_TLT.release_note: Uses matching Alpaca IEX daily bars only; no forward fill or estimated values are used.

XLY_XLP.formula: XLY split-adjusted close / XLP split-adjusted close on matching trading dates

IWM_SPY.display_name: iShares Russell 2000 ETF / SPDR S&P 500 ETF Ratio
IWM_SPY.formula: IWM split-adjusted close / SPY split-adjusted close on matching trading dates
IWM_SPY.release_note: Uses matching Alpaca IEX daily bars only; no forward fill or estimated values are used.

SMH_SPY.display_name: VanEck Semiconductor ETF / SPDR S&P 500 ETF Ratio
SMH_SPY.formula: SMH split-adjusted close / SPY split-adjusted close on matching trading dates
SMH_SPY.release_note: The initial archive uses matching Nasdaq historical closes. New observations use matching Alpaca IEX daily bars only; no forward fill or estimated values are used.

NEW_HIGH_LOW_BREADTH.display_name: S&P 500 New High / New Low Breadth
NEW_HIGH_LOW_BREADTH.source_name: Calculated from Alpaca Market Data API constituent prices
NEW_HIGH_LOW_BREADTH.formula: (Stocks at a 252-trading-day high - stocks at a 252-trading-day low) / valid constituents * 100
NEW_HIGH_LOW_BREADTH.release_note: Current-constituent proxy refreshed after each US trading day. Historical membership changes are not reconstructed; at least 95% constituent coverage is required.

SP500_ABOVE_200DMA.display_name: S&P 500 Percent of Stocks Above 200-Day Moving Average
SP500_ABOVE_200DMA.source_name: Calculated from Alpaca Market Data API constituent prices
SP500_ABOVE_200DMA.release_note: Calculated from current S&P 500 constituents and refreshed after each US trading day. Historical membership changes are not reconstructed; at least 95% constituent coverage is required.

TSMC_REVENUE_YOY.release_note: Historical archive is parsed from MOPSOV single-company monthly operating revenue for TSMC 2330. The updater merges newly available months and keeps existing history if a source request fails.

DEXJPUS.release_note: The latest Google Finance USD/JPY quote is merged into the existing historical archive; no complete-history download is repeated.

BOJ_POLICY_RATE.source_name: BIS Central Bank Policy Rates / Bank of Japan

source_urls.label: BIS Central Bank Policy Rates - Japan
Bank of Japan monetary policy decisions

BOJ_POLICY_RATE.release_note: BIS long, spliced policy-rate series D.JP, compiled with the Bank of Japan. It uses the main policy target or instrument for each regime; target ranges are represented by their midpoint unless otherwise specified.

BOJ_OVERNIGHT_CALL_RATE.source_name: Bank of Japan Time-Series Data Search
BOJ_OVERNIGHT_CALL_RATE.release_note: Official FM01'STRDCLUCON daily average. This is the observed uncollateralized overnight market rate, not the BOJ policy target. Missing non-business days are not filled.

BOJ_IMPLIED_RATE_3M_TONA.display_name: BOJ Implied Rate from 3-Month TONA Futures
BOJ_IMPLIED_RATE_3M_TONA.release_note: Calculated as 100 minus the settlement price of the nearest listed 3-Month TONA futures contract. It is a market-implied short-rate proxy, not an official BOJ policy-rate forecast.

JAPAN_CORE_CPI_YOY.display_name: Japan Core Consumer Price Index Year-over-Year
JAPAN_CORE_CPI_YOY.release_note: Official nationwide all-items CPI excluding fresh food. The updater reads the published year-over-year series directly and merges the 2020-base and 2025-base files without interpolation.

TOKYO_CORE_CPI_YOY.display_name: Tokyo Ku-area Core Consumer Price Index Year-over-Year
TOKYO_CORE_CPI_YOY.release_note: Official Ku-area of Tokyo all-items CPI excluding fresh food. It is normally published before the nationwide CPI. No interpolation or forward fill is used.

JAPAN_CASH_EARNINGS_YOY.source_name: Japan Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare
JAPAN_CASH_EARNINGS_YOY.frequency: Monthly preliminary, revised by final release
JAPAN_CASH_EARNINGS_YOY.release_note: Nationwide total cash earnings, establishments with five or more employees. The latest preliminary observation is retained until the official final workbook for the same month is published, then replaced by the revised value.

US_JAPAN_2Y_SPREAD.formula: US 2-Year Treasury Yield - Japan 2-Year JGB Yield

CFTC_JPY_SPECULATIVE_NET_POSITIONS.release_note: CFTC Legacy Futures Only report for CME Japanese Yen futures (contract 097741). Net speculative positions are non-commercial long contracts minus non-commercial short contracts. The report date is Tuesday and the report is normally published Friday; no forward fill is used.
